notes.title: Ready to Find More Junk?
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy, Pilots![/h1]

[b]Thanks for playing Barn Finders: The Pilot![/b] We hope you loved rummaging through barns for treasures. But hold on—the full version of Barn Finders offers even more chaos, laughs, and riches!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/9a34ca4aea835697f529d4f4338de598a5caea4d.gif[/img]
[b]What Awaits You in the Full Version?[/b]
[list]
[b][*] 11 Wild Locations: From creepy barns to abandoned military bases—even the moon!
[*] Hundreds of Treasures: Collect antiques, cars, gold, and more for massive profits.
[*] Pawnshop Fun: Clean, repair, and sell your finds, while keeping customers (and Uncle Billy) happy.
[*] Auctions and Rivalries: Compete with other treasure hunters to snag the best loot.[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/f6c420bf95bbce4ec6643cc840aba514eff73471.gif[/img]
The pilot was just a taste—the full version is packed with more junk, surprises, and Ammerykan weirdness. So grab your overalls and get ready to explore like never before!

[b]Uncle Billy Says...[/b]
“Kid, the full version’s got everything you need to strike it rich. Don’t miss out—Barn Finders ain’t for quitters!”

P.S. Our friends are working on a cool game called Car Dealer Simulator! Check out their trailer here: [![Watch the Trailer](https://img.youtube.com/vi/sD_JJ6GSBaQ/maxresdefault.jpg)][previewyoutube=sD_JJ6GSBaQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Thrill of Auctions and Hidden Treasures
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Barn Finders![/h1]

Today, we’re diving into one of the most exciting aspects of Barn Finders—the auction mechanic and the intriguing variety of storage units you can discover.

[h2]Auction Mechanics: How It Works[/h2]
In Barn Finders, auctions are where the real action begins. You’ll compete against other bidders to win abandoned storage units that could hold untold treasures... or just a bunch of junk! The thrill of the auction lies in the mystery—you can only see a portion of what’s inside before making your bid. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/97349e4990274dfae9d0613382a3bd2f39ba75d9.gif[/img]
[h2]Unique Storage Units: From Pirate Treasures to Mysterious Spaces[/h2]
But what makes these auctions even more exciting are the unique and themed storage units you’ll come across. Imagine walking into a storage unit filled with pirate-themed decor—could there be an ancient chest filled with gold?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/78c89cd1f145a92e6f5f4f9e6c8fa5dd9c58dfeb.gif[/img]
Or perhaps you find yourself staring at what seems to be an empty unit, with just a few dusty boxes and an old ladder. Don’t be fooled; even the most unassuming spaces can hold the rarest items! Each unit is a gamble, and that’s what makes every auction a heart-pounding experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/e9da6cb2353ee2ca14cd5a59277c1b13dbb34e6e.gif[/img]
[h2]Have You Checked Out the New SuperHero Map?[/h2]
Speaking of exciting new content, have you explored the new SuperHero Map yet? It’s a free addition packed with new adventures and items to discover. If you haven’t checked it out, now’s the perfect time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419243/8be9de2d9465e8f3e84473a82dfea1450d3c0d92.png[/img]

[b]We know you love free game samples, so we've got something special for you! If you haven't checked it out yet, don't miss the Car Dealer Simulator Prologue. It's a great way to get a taste of what's to come in the full game. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

[u]Happy gaming, and stay tuned for more updates![/u]

notes.title: Play BarnFinders now!
notes.content:
This is it, we're finally here, Barn Finders has just been released on Steam!
Now everyone can dive into the strange and amazing world of Ammeryka and become the greatest barn-treasure finder in the world :wink: .
Now, there a couple of things that you should know:

- First of all remember that thanks to your combined efforts you've crossed the 2nd goal in our Community Challenge, so game should have a 10% launch discount! But because we have the best community in the world, as a 'thank you' we've decided to make it a full 15% instead. ENJOY! 

- This is not a fire-and-forget game. We trully belive that Barn Finders is somethins amazing and unique and we will continue to support this game after today. More news on this matter are to come. And if you encounter any problems while playing please let us know at our Steam message board.

[u]- We will celebrate the launch of this game with a special stream. You'll be able to see it on our Steam right NOW![/u]

- As we mentioned before there's a special 15% loyalty discount for everyone, who bought one of the 12 most popular PlayWay games.

- Barn Finders is also available is 3 game bundles, so you can get 2 or 3 amazing games at once, for a special price!
